sql:
with p as (select distinct market_ticker, series_ticker from incentive_programs where superseded_at is null and disappeared_at is null and incentive_type='liquidity' and end_date>now()
 and series_ticker ~ '^KX(GOLD|SILVER|COPPER|AUDUSD|USDJPY|GBPUSD|USDMXN|USDCAD|EURUSD|BTC|ETH|SOL|HYPE)EVENT$|^KX(SENATENOM|GOVNOM|DPRESPRIMARY|RPRESPRIMARY|AGRACE|TREASRACE|SOSRACE|AUDITORRACE)$')
select case when series_ticker ~ '(GOLD|SILVER|COPPER)EVENT' then 'metal_event' when series_ticker ~ 'USD|EUR' then 'fx_event' when series_ticker ~ 'EVENT' then 'crypto_event' else 'nom_race' end fam,
 count(*) live_mkts,
 sum(case when exists (select 1 from incentive_market_snapshots s where s.market_ticker=p.market_ticker and s.at > now()-interval '2 days') then 1 else 0 end) watched_2d
from p group by 1 order by 1
